2173-3698-4574-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2173-3698-4574-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

147-4247-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-4247-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-4247-7166.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4247-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Naru Meha, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-2921-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3330-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2074-2511-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1018-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Skullwinder and exiling Ephemerate.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

943-4235-7008-7069.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying {1}{G}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, targeting any land you control.
Activate a land you control by tapping it, adding three mana of any color due to the ability given to it by Tectonic Split.
Badgermole Cub's second ability triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the land.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and the other land.
Repeat from step 2.
943-4235-7008-7069.notes: Once you have excess mana, you can untap other lands instead of [Land that Taps to Add Multiple Mana]].

413-725-6478-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
413-725-6478-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to Sin's toughness.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Arbor Adherent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2034-5058-6351.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1339-2558-2829-6666.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2558-2829-6666.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Insect.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

1690-2364-2538-3836.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact permanent in hand that can be cast for at most {1} due to Urza.
1690-2364-2538-3836.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2364-2538-3836.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

864-1987-2187-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
864-1987-2187-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Possessed Skaab.
When Eternal Witness and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-2187-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1479-2719-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

225-5175-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-5175-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

2882-3079-4659-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to any creature you control that does not have a cycling ability.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
2882-3079-4659-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {C}{C}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

948-2060-2433-2445-2486.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
You have at least one +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
948-2060-2433-2445-2486.description:
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Ooze creature token, which will enter the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters due to Branching Evolution and Master Chef.
Rosie Cotton of South Lane triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1479-1671-2692.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-2692.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Felidar Retreat, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
